Each targeted fact binds the certification event, evidence row, evidence metadata, all governing schemas, producer packet hash, owner authorization actor and record, exact fact value, structured reason tuple, store trail head, and current non-revoked state.

Missing or duplicate rows, digest drift, or wrong target surface blocks dispatch.

Contextual review also binds raw independent Opus 5 and Sonnet 5 worker records through qamus/schemas/two-vote-worker-record.schema.json and tools/validate_two_vote_worker_records.py. Sessions are distinct, neither worker sees the other's submission, and raw metadata proves the actual selected model.
Radical evidence metadata binds the exact upstream ownership producer row, schema, artifact, metadata, packet, loc-surface index, and manifest hashes.
The builder consumes exact A4 manifest, canonical occurrence, disposition rows and metadata, disposition schema, and four payload envelopes. Directory-only acceptance is forbidden.
The builder recomputes every raw-byte hash and confirms the website contract and validator hashes recorded in the A4 manifest.

A4 currently supports only neutral primary canonical spans 0:2 with mocc:p007:61:5:4 and 2:11 with null morpheme identity. The shorter appearances map these to 0:2 and 2:10. Offset 8, stem identity, and possessive-pronoun identity remain candidate alternatives unless exact integrated evidence and owner certification support a richer compiled state.
The four authoritative appearances are exactly 01133eb5431b:u0:x1:w3, 3041d6f44a27:u11:x1:w3, 65d3d5c51f24:u0:x2:w3, and 7f1f8b8e29e6:u0:x0:w3.

Every payload carries appearance.binding_state candidate_requires_renderer_capability_acceptance, projection.public_projection_eligible false, a closed six-field canonical_to_appearance_span_map, and a distinct top-level appearance_binding_hash. appearance.page_local is excluded from the hash.

P007 protection requires semantic validation plus frozen dispatch-SHA tree-entry equality, every tracked blob byte, and absence of non-ignored untracked additions. The deterministic tree digest is recorded in the vertical manifest.

Rich-at-rest and rich-hover compile from the same vertical artifact and preserve identical segment, ownership, fact, and projection identities. Translation requires exact certified contextual facts; unresolved context remains explicit.

The preinstalled harness trigger set is any existence of the builder, builder test, owner-binding validator, owner-binding test, vertical manifest, or vertical report. If none exists it reports not materialized without PASS; if any exists it requires all implementation artifacts, runs both test modules, and runs --check-sample. No glob or partial skip is allowed.
